evidence.quote: A VideoCardz source confirmed that one board partner already has RTX 50 Super GPUs on hand, but Nvidia has allegedly told the company that the products are on hold because of the price of 3GB GDDR7 memory chips.
evidence.one_line: Per an unnamed VideoCardz source, Nvidia allegedly told a board partner that RTX 50 Super products are on hold due to 3GB GDDR7 chip prices; partner already has units on hand.
evidence.speaker: unnamed VideoCardz source / Nvidia (allegedly)

evidence.quote: The RTX 50 Super GPUs are rumored to have 3GB GDDR7 chips , which offers 50% more capacity than the 2GB found in current-gen RTX 50-series graphics cards.
evidence.one_line: RTX 50 Super GPUs are rumoured to use 3GB GDDR7 chips offering 50% more capacity than the 2GB in current RTX 50 cards.
evidence.speaker: tomshardware.com (citing rumour)

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, these chips cost twice or thrice as much as their 2GB variants, which will likely push the retail price of these cards beyond Nvidia’s envisioned MSRP.
evidence.one_line: 3GB GDDR7 chips reportedly cost two to three times as much as 2GB variants, likely pushing RTX 50 Super retail prices above Nvidia's MSRP.
evidence.speaker: tomshardware.com (journalist)

evidence.quote: Nvidia used to supply VRAM chips alongside GPU dies to its board partners, but it changed this policy in late 2025 as the memory chip crisis unfolded.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia changed its policy in late 2025 so board partners must source their own VRAM chips rather than receiving them with GPU dies.
evidence.speaker: tomshardware.com (reporting)

evidence.quote: SK hynix, one of the big three memory chip manufacturers, even says that 2027 is set to be the “worst year” for the memory shortage and said that the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.one_line: SK hynix says 2027 will be the worst year for the memory shortage and the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.speaker: SK hynix

evidence.quote: with the company not announcing a new GPU at CES 2026 . This is the first time this has happened in five years
evidence.one_line: Nvidia did not announce a new GPU at CES 2026, the first time in five years it has not done so.
evidence.speaker: tomshardware.com (reporting)

evidence.quote: Its latest AI systems are now more expensive than ever, with memory accounting for 25% of the BOM, as costs have soared by nearly 500%.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia's latest AI systems: memory accounts for 25% of the bill of materials, with costs up nearly 500%.
evidence.speaker: tomshardware.com (reporting)

candidates.looks_at: RTX 50 Super launch timing amid GDDR7 memory pricing
candidates.question: Will Nvidia's RTX 50 Super GPUs (RTX 5080 Super, 5070 Ti Super, 5070 Super or 5050 9GB) launch at retail by 2027-02-28?
candidates.settled_by: Nvidia product announcements and retail availability reports
